Name: Plumbob Hats from The Sims
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][i][center][b]~ Plumbobs For Farmer~[/b][/center][/i]
[/size][center][size=4][i]Five plumbobs for your farmer![/i]

[/size]So it's been in my plans for a while to make some plumbobs for stardew valley,
I really wanted my farmer to wear one.
However, I wanted to make it bigger but then;
Either it covered the farmer's face,
or part of it disappeared.
I still think this version looks pretty nice!

So you have:
Green (Happy)
Yellow (Fine)
Orange (Uncomfortable)
Red (Angry)

And I added one more as a bonus; a pink one for feeling flirty!

You can get them for 20 coins in the hats' mouse![/center]
[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/center][/b]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
